rationale: Repository-owned launchers and clients have been migrated to canonical V2 targets.
No package or pythonpath entry requires apps/backend.
Retaining a delegating package would preserve an unnecessary runtime dependency.

guard.behavior: Any Python source recreated below apps/backend fails the architecture gate.

external_compatibility: The HTTP /api/v1/* tombstone remains in windagent_api and returns 410 Gone; it contains no legacy business logic.
